name: Bird Rock Coffee Roasters
shortReview: The gold standard. Their cold brew is what happens when someone actually cares about extraction time — dark, clean, no sugar needed. Drink it black or don't drink it at all.

name: Better Buzz Coffee
shortReview: San Diego signature. I always add vanilla cream top and make the cold brew dangerously smooth for something this caffeinated. The coffee itself is strong and dark. Many people come for "the best drink ever", which is too sweet to my liking. Cold brew + cream top is a kiss on my lips.

name: Seven Seas Coffee Roasters
shortReview: Yes! Another peanut butter coffee! It is nitro so it's even smoothier. I tried it at La Mesa Farmers Market, which happens every Friday afternoon.

name: Cargo Cafe
shortReview: Peanut Butter Cream Top Cold Brew is DELISH！PB makes the whole world better. Plus, it's a cream top!! The sweetness only comes from the cream, and the whole drink is just so smooth and fragrant. OMG. Try it.

name: Zumbar Coffee & Tea
shortReview: The Humming bird cold brew & nitro is my go to! Add a splash of old milk and enjoy the day! It's a bit dark roasted but not so bitter, and not so acidic either. A good well balanced cold brew when you just want to enjoy an easy ice coffee to start your day,

name: Jaunt Coffee Roaster
shortReview: Not a fan of ginger but a big fan of Jaunt's Orange Ginger Cold Brew! You can't really taste the spiciness of ginger. It offers a well balanced sweetness and refreshingness. Very smooth and hard to stop.

name: Seahorse Coffee
shortReview: This coffee wakes you up. Man, it is dark. And strong. Both on the flavor and on the power. Good for a day when you want to go out there to conquer the world.

name: La Colombe
shortReview: Oat Half Tan - an iced drink that combines 50/50 of their on-tap cold brew and oat milk draft latte. It offers a sweet yet coffee-forward flavor. Creamier and stronger than a regular latte.

name: Trident Coffee Coronado
shortReview: Call for Every Nitro Cold Brew Zealot in SD!! Nitros withs so many interesting taste profiles. All on the bitter side but a splash of oats or milk will bring out the creaminess. Son of Son of a Sailor is a good start. Daily Rations has a very unique bourbon barrel taste and you can't find it anywhere else!

name: Clayton's Coffee Shop
shortReview: Very unassuming storefront where you order coffee from a pick up window. But it's weirdly good. Even for the cold brew it's very toasty, if that's something you like. It's not so strong either. I can probably take a nap right after. But I like it way much better than any other Instagrammable coffee shops on the island.

name: Rikka Fikka
shortReview: Most famous for their matcha, but the cold brew is also a rare find! It's light and fruity but not too acidic, with a floral after taste.  I didn't even need a splash milk as I normally do with cold brews. It already has a subtle but natural sweetness from the coffee itself. Very pleasant and 優しい (yasashi)

name: Acento Coffee Roasters
shortReview: OK I cheated. It's not cold brew, it's Freddo, basically an ice shaken espresso with a homemade citrus-based syrup. The duo of espresso + jammy citrus is refreshing and very unique. This place used to be one of my fav, until the staff became vary sassy about tipping :) (They might ask where you are from if you dare to push that "no tip" button).
